subject: Nimbus Dataworks — Live Customer Fishbowl + Mini Booth (EdgeSummit) — sync and MDF
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@nimbusdataworks.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@nimbusdataworks.com

Subject: Co-hosted live customer fishbowl + mini booth at EdgeSummit (Sept) — brief proposal

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the intro last week. Nimbus would love to co-run a small-format customer fishbowl (live customers on stage, moderated discussion) paired with a mini shared booth at EdgeSummit in Seattle (Sept 14-16). Our goals: drive 2–3 strong qualified demo meetings per day at the show and a short on-stage piece we can repurpose as a demo clip for paid channels.

High-level ask:
- Co-funded mini booth (10x10 shared island) + shared staffing (2 people from each side on peak days)
- One 30–40 minute fishbowl session on Day 2 (panel + live Q&A) co-branded and promoted to our joint list
- $12k MDF contribution requested from Redwood to cover booth fees, on-site AV, and shared promo (we can provide vendor invoices)

I've attached a short partner proposal with estimated line items. If this looks reasonable, would love to set a 30-minute sync next week to align scope and confirm dates.

Attached: Nimbus_Partner_Proposal.pdf

Cheers,
Elena Morris
Head of Strategic Partners
Nimbus Dataworks
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-hosted live customer fishbowl + mini booth at EdgeSummit (Sept) — brief proposal

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the attached proposal. Happy to explore — EdgeSummit is a good fit for the vertical plays we want to highlight. A couple quick clarifying questions before we lock a sync:

- MDF: can you break down the $12k asks into vendor vs marketing (we prefer a line-item SOW so we can route to finance).
- Audience: who are the proposed customers for the fishbowl (names/companies or personas) and can Nimbus share any opt-in promotion commitments (email sends, social amplifiers)?
- AV/support: will Nimbus cover on-site lead capture or do you want Redwood to bring our tablet + badge scanner?

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Monday 5/4 10:00–10:30 PT. If that works I’ll book and pull in Marissa for MDF ops and Ben for booth logistics.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Grace O'Connor
Head of Partner Go-to-Market, Redwood Inference

Looping in early notes on MDF/ops — draft numbers below (quick calc, happy to refine):

Estimated line items (total $12,000 proposed by Nimbus):
- Booth space surcharge & drayage: $4,500 (vendor invoice required)
- AV for fishbowl session (mics + streaming): $2,200
- Joint promotion (email sends, paid social boost): $3,000
- On-site collateral & logistics (printing, lead capture): $1,300

Redwood contribution options: we can either do a straight 50/50 split ($6k each) or Redwood can front $8k if Nimbus can guarantee an additional 4 paid demo meetings post-event (we'll need that in SOW). Finance prefers an SOW + vendor invoices for MDF reimbursement.

Booth staffing: Ben — can you confirm if two Redwood engineers/SDRs can attend on Day 2 (14th) and Day 3 morning (15th) if we go 50/50? Also, we should coordinate a shared staffing schedule and badge allocation.

I attached a mock staffing roster (Booth_Staffing_Roster.xlsx) and a short Redwood MDF SOW template (Redwood_MDF_SOW_v1.pdf) we can send after sign-off.

—Marissa
